text: High starts from other reviewers  had a big contribution to our money and time waste here. They are a bit cheaper than any places nearby but for a good reason. Me and my friend ordered Aroma massage but just soaked in oil for one hour without any massage! The massager did not care about our request and keep talking with their phones.. really terrible experience! After the massage we said we are not happy at all! And they said your problem and get out from our shop! just this much simple!

Best foot massage I got in Chiang Mai. Only 200 baht and the woman was very good and applied a good amount of pressure. My partner and I both got massages and were very happy. Not a very fancy place but that didn't matter to me.

Picked this place, local to where I was, on the basis of the two 5* reviews, wanting a good massage for a shoulder issue. Was a little surprised to have my ass patted on the stairs up to the slightly down-at-heel massage area, and even more so when a hand 'accidentally' ("Ooops, sorry!") found its way onto my meat and 2 veg as we got settled in. Was informed later that this is in the middle of the red light district. Once we'd got passed the 'confusion' of why I was there I got a reasonable massage for a standard price.
